money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: The official currency is the US Dollar ($US). Exchange for other currencies isn't available. Bitcoin became legal tender in El Salvador in September 2021. However, not all vendors accept Bitcoin and it is in the early stages of adoption. Credit cards aren't widely accepted outside major centres. ATMs aren't reliable. Only change money and use ATMs in banks, hotels or shopping malls (see 'Safety').

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences are severe and include long prison sentences in local jails. Authorities will arrest you for illegal drugs if you're either: carrying even a very small amount of drugs, or with someone who's using them If you're found driving under the influence of alcohol or other drugs, authorities will arrest you. Border officials may screen you for drugs, including on departure. - Carrying or using drugs

laws.rule: Public displays of affection may attract negative attention. Same-sex relationships are legal in El Salvador, but the country is conservative. Same-sex marriages are recognised in El Salvador.

laws.rule: If you injure or kill someone in a road accident, authorities may arrest or detain you for a local trial. It's illegal to take photographs of official buildings. Check with local authorities before taking photos.

laws.rule: To drive a vehicle, you'll need a current Australian driver's licence (digital driver’s licences may not be accepted).
laws.heading: Driving permit

laws.rule: At ISTU recreational parks, follow rangers' instructions, use waste containers, do not cut or take plants, and do not bring or use firearms or bladed weapons. Unauthorised mobile vending is prohibited. Swimming pools require swimwear made of spandex, lycra or nylon. These are ISTU park conditions, not a rule for every beach or private attraction in El Salvador.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Buy a tourist card at the airport, allowing a visit of up to 90 days. El Salvador is in the CA-4 agreement with Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua: the 90 days cover land travel between the four and run from the first entry into any of them.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Tourist card bought at the airport (CA-4, up to 90 days).
visa-preparation.before_departure: If routing through the US or Canada, meet their entry or transit rules (an eTA for Canada). Make sure the passport is stamped on entry.
visa-preparation.useful_stay: Up to 90 days across the CA-4 countries; extend before expiry at the Centro de Gobierno in San Salvador. Non-tourists or longer stays need a visa.

steps.step: Buy the tourist card at the airport and make sure the passport is stamped.
Count CA-4 days from the first entry into any member country; extend at the Centro de Gobierno in San Salvador before expiry.
Pay the departure tax if the airline ticket doesn't include it; some land crossings close at 6pm.

documents: Proof of legal relationship when travelling with children
